description.en:
Sends a character along a path through up to 8 points, starting from where it stands.
The points come after the speed and the second value, one array per point: [x, y, z] or [x, y, z, rotY]. The native reads arrays until it meets an argument that is not an array; arrays with fewer than 3 elements are skipped, and only the first 8 points are kept.
The ev_main helpers EvLowMdlSetPath3 to EvLowMdlSetPath8 wrap it for 3 to 8 points; their arguments are named (_hdl, _spd, _trg, _pnt1...).
Wait for the end with CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_IS_MOVING.
Character moves and turns are run by a movement manager with 16 slots, one per character. CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG, CMND_CHR_PATH_SETUP and the CMND_CHR_TURN_* commands take a free slot for the character when it has none.
Movement speed; the scripts pass EV_MINI_CHARA_MOVE_SPEED_WALK (0.3).
Second value passed to the move routine with the speed (named _trg in ev_main); the scripts pass 0.0, 1 or 10.0. Its exact role was not traced.
First point [x, y, z] or [x, y, z, rotY].
Further points, up to 8 in total.

Slot number (0 to 15) of the character in the movement manager.
null if all 16 slots are taken, the script system is not ready, or too few arguments are given.

examples.case: Walking a character through three points (real usage, from ev42100900.nut)
